## Type of change
- [ ] `feat` — new feature
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix
- [ ] `refactor` — no behavior change
- [ ] `test` — new or updated tests
- [ ] `docs` — documentation
- [ ] `chore` — CI, config, dependencies

## Tests

- [ ] `bash tests/integration/test_*.sh` — 0 failures (if applicable)
